The television displays a woman with long dark hair and a light blue shirt looking at a document. Yellow text overlays appear at the bottom of the TV. The man looks at the screen with an exaggerated expression of surprise, his mouth open wide. (2) The shot transitions to a woman with bangs and a white floral puff-sleeve dress standing in a brightly lit room with white walls. She looks directly at the camera, smiling broadly and speaking. Large yellow subtitles appear in the lower third of the frame. (3) The man returns to the frame. From the right side, hands reach in to place a white pacifier in his mouth and hand him a blue baby bottle, a silver and blue formula can, and a diaper. He holds these items with a bewildered expression. A pregnancy test showing two red lines is then moved close to the camera lens. (4) An extreme close-up of the man's face shows him with bulging eyes and a shocked expression. Finally, the woman in the floral dress reappears, smiling and bowing slightly toward the camera to conclude the scene.
